addr: 104, Mahatma Gandhi Rd, Haridevpur, Shanthala Nagar, Shivaji Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India

rev.t: This historic building on MG Road, Bengaluru, renovated decades ago, offers a glimpse into the city's architectural heritage. While parking is available, it's limited to tenants. The presence of the iconic Lake View Ice Cream Cafe adds to its allure, providing a good dining experience amidst the city's hustle and bustle.
LAKEVIEW MILK BAR FAVOURITE PLACE IN BANGALORE
Good old vibes of bangalore.  Good atmosphere at peak MG road.
